subject: C4 Pure C# Agent Engine reality check and task upgrade

findings.detail: PureCSharpAgentEngine was previously delivered with only a mock echo client (DefaultPureModelClient) and single-step RunTurnAsync without tool-result reinjection loop. It does not constitute a true Node-free agent loop.
Desktop RealSessionBootstrap still strictly requires node.exe and Pi cli.js. App does not wire PureCSharpAgentEngine into live desktop sessions.

Authenticated gh inspection completed for user-shared candidates: claw-sharp/ClawSharp (MIT, C#) has complete QueryLoopRunner and SSE streaming; daemonicai/dmon-core (MPL-2.0, C#) is available; tkleisas/thuvu (MIT, C#) is local-only; JupiterTheWarlock/pi-agent.cs does not exist.

decision: Upgrade C4 to NATIVE-CS. Implement full Agent Loop with multi-turn tool result feedback, real SSE model client (OpenAI/Anthropic compatible), production tool dispatcher, and wire into desktop session bootstrap. Verify in Node-free environment.
